Ava: heads-up: ran a multi-node TP job that timed out at step ~120. Symptoms: long all-reduce stalls + cascading kvcache evictions, then heartbeat loss. logs attached. anyone seen this pattern? :eyes:

perf-bot: [perf-test] job redwood/tp-long-run #876 failed: timeout 00:45:12. Summary: last rank lost heartbeat. trace: http://ci/perf/trace/171901 

Sanjay: did we roll kernel-selector heuristics in the last runtime deploy? i recall a change that switches small allreduces to tree for latency reasons

Li: i bisected -- regression introduced after runtime PR 9f3b1c. that PR changed collective path selection for >512KB messages (now picks tree-allreduce). with skewed tensor shard sizes that increases sync latency, seems to line up with the timeout

Mike: confirmed from our nvprof traces: long `ncclAllReduce` stalls show up, GPU compute idle while the kvcache eviction path churns. looks like eviction is happening mid-step and blocking progress

Ava: flamegraph summary: http://ci/perf/trace/171901/top.svg -> hot stacks: allreduce_wait -> kv_cache_evict -> kernel_selector -> schedule_batch. attaching short log: 
```
[rank2] step=119 evict kvcache shard=7 size=3.2MB reason=mem_pressure
[rank2] wait on allreduce: timeout=120000ms, peers=3
```

Li: quick repro command i used (4-node TP, 2x2 tensor parallel, batch=16, seq=2048):
```
./bin/run_tp_repro --nodes 4 --tp-split 2 --batch 16 --seq_len 2048 --seed 42 --log-level debug
```

Sanjay: my hypothesis: batching heuristic groups heterogeneous sequences into same micro-batch; kernel selector picks a higher-throughput kernel that increases per-rank buffer usage and forces kvcache eviction mid-forward, which then serializes on all-reduce. net effect = comm/compute overlap lost and tail latency balloon.

Mike: i ran a quick variant: toggling `--prefer-ring-allreduce=true` on the repro drops tail allreduce latency from ~1.8s -> ~300ms and the job completes. so it smells like the tree algorithm + uneven message sizes is the culprit, but ring can hurt throughput elsewhere.

Ava: plan: (1) add micro-benchmark to exercise small/medium allreduce paths with skewed shard sizes, (2) add metric pairing allreduce bytes -> kv-evict-rate to alerts, (3) revert kernel selector change on canary and observe. i'll open an issue and request a canary rollback. @Sanjay can you run nv-nsight profiling on dedicated infra Monday?

Sanjay: will do. opened issue #2245 with repro, traces, and perf flame. scheduling nv-nsight profiling on monday morning. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: scheduled CI rerun: tp-kv-evict-canary on dedicated infra.
